senses.definition: and (Nu 32:34) עֲטָרֹת n.pr.loc. Αταρωθ, etc.:
Nu 32:3 (+ דִּיכוֹן, etc)—mod. Aṭṭarûs, c. 8 miles NNW. from Dibon—built by Gad Nu 32:34 (+ ד׳, עֲרֹעֵר, and also)
עַטְרֹת שׁוֹפָן v 35 (Sam. ע׳ שפים, v. Di; site unknown).
W. of Jordan, conject. as to sites v. in Di Buhl<sup>Geogr. 172</sup>:
on border between Ephr. and Benj. Jos 16:2, = עַטְרוֹת אַדָּר v 5; 18:13.
on E. border of Ephr. Jos 16:7.
עַטְרוֹת בֵּית יוֹאָב 1 Ch 2:54 in Judah; a ‘son’ of Salma (+ Bethlehem, al.).
